title: Difficult navigation
body: I've been through 66 days, but the app doesn't show any results or totals, on the third day it shows me the 66th day. The navigation was unclear, and I accidentally reset the results a couple of times because I was looking for other options. And it still didn't work to abandon the option: turn on the screen lock. I didn't need this item, but it didn't clear up in the goal settings, which left me open for many days. It also failed to set up some goals so that, for example, the amount of water consumed would not increase every week - drinking 4 liters a day is absurd. But it's a good idea.
author: Филала

title: Es de paga
body: Eso no tiene nada de malo, pero no ofrece una sesión gratuita, o algo. Fuera de eso, me molesta que sesión presente como una aplicación que te salvará la vida para luego hacerte miles de preguntas, y resultar que era de paga, si vas a cobras dímelo desde el inicio, no me hagas perder el tiempo.
